run_store_coco_jpeg_images: run the CLI tool to extract COCO-Stuff JPEG images from an HDF5 file for FID computation
run_store_coco_jpeg_images_with_filter: run the tool with --filter_hd to extract only images matching a Hamming distance threshold
run_store_coco_jpeg_images_val_split: run the tool with --split val to extract validation set images from the HDF5 dataset
review_main_function: review the main function that loads HDF5 images, filters by Hamming distance, and saves JPEGs
refactor_main_function: refactor the main function to support additional image formats beyond JPEG output
